def factor_vol_amplified_20d_reversal(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20, high_threshold=1.5, low_threshold=0.6)
    vol_mult = vol_ratio.clip(0.5, 2.0)
    rev_20d = -(df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(20) - 1)
    factor = rev_20d * vol_mult
    df_copy["factor_vol_amplified_20d_reversal"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_vol_amplified_20d_reversal"]
description: Mutation of parent factor_vol_weighted_reversal_lagged_vol. Preserves the core volume-contingent reversal mechanism but simplifies by removing the two-horizon blend and the 2-day volume lag. Instead, a single 20-day reversal window is directly amplified by the current continuous volume ratio, clipped to prevent extreme values. The hypothesis is that medium-term reversals are more reliable under elevated trading volume (indicating climax behavior), and focusing on one clean horizon reduces noise and improves interpretability and robustness. Parent strengths: strong IC and ICIR from volume-conditioned reversals are maintained.
